content.text: Iragi lyâge omuntu orhînya Nyakasane, omuntu oyumva anunîrwe n’amarhegeko gâge.
iburha lyâge lyâyishilushana hano igulu, n’obûko bw’abashinganyanya bwâbona omugisho.
Omu mwâge mwâyunjula buhirhi n’ebirugu, n’obushinganyanya bwâge buli bwa kuyôrha ensiku n’amango.
Omu mwizimya ali kamole k’ab’emirhima nkana, obwonjo, olukogo, oburhimanya, ye nnabyo.
Omuntu mwinjà abâ wa lukogo, ebyâge arharhînya bwabihoza abandi, ebyâge byoshi burhondekezi bubirhegeka.
Omuntu mushinganyanya ntà mango ahuligane, na ntà mango ânayibagirwe.
Arhayôboha mwanzi mubî, omurhima gwâge guyôrha gudekerire, bulya Nnâmahanga acîkubagira.
Omurhima gwâge kusêra gusêra, arhishi entemu byo bici. abashombanyi bâge enshonyi zababumba erhi anasinza.
Arhahimwa kuhâna n’okushîbirira abakenyi, obushinganyanya bwâge burhakahwa kuderhwa, irenge lyâge kugandâza lyanagandâza.
Enkola-maligo ekamubona enazizimire emurhima, ekenyeze amîno eje yagangabala, enyifinjo z’abalenzi kufanânda zinafanânda.
